rationale: The tests-latest and tests-older matrix jobs re-fetch rebar3 dependencies on every run (monthly schedule plus push/PR) with no dependency cache, while the basic job in the same workflow already caches ~/.cache keyed on rebar.config. Pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (Cache dependency downloads) reports a measured benefit and its preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching occurs, and the cache key covers the manifest (rebar.config) plus environment (runner.os and matrix.otp). Adding the same cache step to the two test jobs preserves every test target and coverage--no jobs or steps are removed and no fail-fast is introduced--while reusing previously fetched dependencies. No new secrets, privileged actions, deployments, or network targets are added; actions/cache@v4 is already used in the workflow.
